navToday.title: Today
navToday.body: The project's home screen. Work assigned to you, overdue items and upcoming due dates are gathered here.

todayGrid.title: Daily Summary
todayGrid.body: Cards: assigned to me, overdue, upcoming due dates and recent changes. New records are created from the top right.

navFiles.title: Documents
navFiles.body: Project files live in this menu. IFC, PDF, CAD and office files are uploaded into folders.

filesTree.title: Folders
filesTree.body: Pick a folder on the left (at the bottom on a phone). Next we will go down to the station folder.

filesUpload.title: Upload
filesUpload.body: Choose a file here or drag it onto the list. Once an IFC is uploaded it is prepared for the Model Viewer automatically.

folderTasarim.title: Design Work
folderTasarim.body: 01-TASARIM ÇALIŞMALARI under Proje Dosyaları. Next opens this folder.

folderOnaya.title: Shared for Approval
folderOnaya.body: 02-Onaya Sunulan (Shared for Approval) — the shared design folder.

folderIstasyonlar.title: Stations
folderIstasyonlar.body: 002-İstasyonlar. Each station has its own folder here.

folderS16.title: S16
folderS16.body: Station S16. The discipline models are inside this folder.

disciplineFolders.title: Five Disciplines
disciplineFolders.body: Five folders on the right: 00-Koordinasyon Modeli, 01-Mimari, 02-Yapısal, 04-Mekanik, 05-Elektrik.

folderMimari.title: Architecture
folderMimari.body: Open the 01-Mimari folder. The model file and its approval status are here.

docsMeta.title: Date and Approval
docsMeta.body: Scroll the table to the right. The date and approval columns are to the right of the name; when the model is ready, Open Model appears.

openModel.title: Open Model
openModel.body: Open Model goes to the IFC viewer. This badge does not appear until conversion has finished.

navViewer.title: Model Viewer
navViewer.body: Uploaded IFC models open here in 3D. Coordination and issues are linked to this scene too.

viewerModels.title: Models
viewerModels.body: Tick one or more models in the list. On a phone, the Models button opens the list.

viewerHud.title: Scene Tools
viewerHud.body: Fit, create issue, schedule (4D) and Ask the Model are on this bar. The tour is over; you can also close it with Skip.
